limits: Only the slave-side CF resultant is reported and summed; no master-side total is fabricated or inferred.
CFN's duplicate total-force row is retained separately and never added to CF; CFS-only total force is retained separately.
Per-owner values are selected slave-side interaction subtotals, not complete body forces or reactions; master-side contributions are absent.
A single contact state supplies no impulse, force history, action/reaction balance, or structural acceptance.
This immutable DAT capture is incomplete after WJCP_034's CF report; WJCP_035 is absent, so all 16 bore pairs cannot be fully verified here.
